title: Gut-training: the impact of two weeks repetitive gut-challenge during exercise on gastrointestinal status, glucose availability, fuel kinetics, and running performance
claims: 耐力跑者进行两周重复肠道挑战（凝胶或真实食物），运动中每 20 分钟补充 30 克碳水（约 90 克/小时），与安慰剂组比较；摘要未报告训练总次数。
两周后，两个碳水训练组的胃肠症状减少；安慰剂组没有同等改善。
1 小时距离测试中，碳水凝胶组提高 5.2%、真实食物组提高 4.3%，安慰剂组下降 2.1%（交互作用 p=0.009）。
作者结论是：两周重复的肠道挑战可以改善胃肠症状与跑步表现；这属于可训练的适应。

verification.note: 读取作者接受稿 PDF（apnm-2016-0453.R4）；正文方法写明“ten days over a period of two weeks”，摘要确实未写总次数。

claimVerification.note: 原文方法：“for ten days over a period of two weeks participants performed 1 h running exercise ... whilst consuming ... 30 g ... every 20 min”；摘要只写“2 weeks of repetitive gut-challenge”，未报告总次数。
原文摘要：“Gastrointestinal symptoms reduced in GC2 on CHO-S (60%; p = 0.008) and CHO-F (63%; p = 0.046); reductions were greater than PLA (p < 0.05)。”
原文摘要：“Distance test improved on CHO-S (5.2%) and CHO-F (4.3%) in GC2, but not on PLA (−2.1%) (trial × time: p = 0.009).”
原文结论 “Two weeks of gut-training with CHO-S and CHO-F improved gastrointestinal symptoms and running performance compared with PLA”；引言称 “the gut can be trained”。删除未经单次方案对照的“不是一次性技巧”。
